name: Ryōan-ji

deep.seasons: Peak late Mar-Apr (blossom) and Nov (maples). Jun rainy, cheap. Winter quiet.
deep.notes: Conbini meals are genuinely good. IC card covers all transit.

docs.entry: Visa-free 90 days for ~70 nationalities; eVisa for others.
docs.insurance: Strongly recommended — medical costs high for foreigners.
docs.agency: eVisa via official MOFA site only — fakes exist.

bestMonths: Late March to April (cherry blossom), November (maple fire)
crowd: Tour buses hit 10:00 to 14:00. At 08:00 you can hear the gravel being raked
bestView: The veranda of the hojo, far right end: the classic angle where the 15th stone hides. Arrive at opening, 08:00
kid: Zen gardens challenge kids to count the stones; the Ryoan-ji bathhouse-style restaurant lets them try hot matcha the old way
kidPicks: Riding the JR Nara line trains
priceNote: Kyoto temples cost less than a coffee. Save the budget for kaiseki one night and konbini breakfasts the rest.

visa.note: Visa-free 90 days for ~70 nationalities. Others need a visa via embassy or the eVisa system.
